zh: 和（某人）打招呼（或问好）；欢迎；迎接
（以某种方式）对…作出反应
映入…的眼帘；传入…的耳中（或鼻中）
en: to say hello to somebody or to welcome them
ex: He greeted all the guests warmly as they arrived.
客人到达时他都热情接待。

zh: （餐馆、商店等处的）门迎，迎宾员
en: a person whose job is to meet and welcome people in a public place such as a restaurant or shop

zh: 问候；招呼；迎接；致意
问候的话；祝辞；贺辞
en: something that you say or do to greet somebody
ex: She waved a friendly greeting.
她友好地挥手致意。

zh: 贺卡
en: a card with a picture on the front and a message inside that you send to somebody on a particular occasion such as their birthday
ex: Millions of greetings cards are sent at Christmas.
在圣诞节期间发送了数百万张贺卡。

zh: a first name for boys, short for Gregory
en: a first name for boys, short for Gregory

zh: 爱交际的；合群的
群居的
en: liking to be with other people
ex: She’s very outgoing and gregarious.
她很外向又善于交际。

zh: in a way that shows that you like to be with other people
群居的
en: in a way that shows that you like to be with other people
ex: to live/nest/grow gregariously
居住/嵌套/成长

zh: 爱交际的；合群的
the fact of animals or birds living in groups
en: the quality of liking to be with other people

zh: 格里历，公历，阳历（自 1582 年以来西方国家使用的历法）
en: the system used since 1582 in Western countries of arranging the months in the year and the days in the months and of counting the years from the birth of Christ

zh: 格里高利圣咏（自中世纪以来教堂演唱的无伴奏圣歌）
en: a type of church music for voices alone, used since the Middle Ages

zh: (1916-2003) a US actor with a pleasant deep voice who usually played honest, good men. He won an Oscar playing the part of a southern lawyer in To Kill a Mockingbird. His other films include Spellbound (1945), Duel in the Sun (1946), Gentleman's Agreement (1947), The Man in the Gray Flannel Suit (1956), Moby Dick (1956), The Omen (1976) and Other People's Money (1991).
en: (1916-2003) a US actor with a pleasant deep voice who usually played honest, good men. He won an Oscar playing the part of a southern lawyer in To Kill a Mockingbird. His other films include Spellbound (1945), Duel in the Sun (1946), Gentleman's Agreement (1947), The Man in the Gray Flannel Suit (1956), Moby Dick (1956), The Omen (1976) and Other People's Money (1991).

zh: （假想的）捣蛋小精灵（机器出故障时人们常归咎于它）
en: an imaginary creature that people blame when a machine suddenly stops working
ex: They blamed gremlins in the printer for the fact that the work was late.
他们把工作迟来归咎于打印机里的人。

zh: 榴弹；手榴弹；枪榴弹
en: a small bomb that can be thrown by hand or fired from a gun
ex: His vehicle was damaged by a rocket-propelled grenade.
他的车毁于火箭榴弹。

zh: 格林纳达人；格林纳达的；格林纳达人的
en: (a person) from Grenada

zh: 英国近卫步兵团的士兵
en: a soldier in the part of the British army known as the Grenadiers or Grenadier Guards

zh: 石榴汁饮料（饮用时掺水或酒）
en: a sweet red liquid that is made from pomegranates (= a fruit with many seeds). It is drunk mixed with water or alcoholic drinks.

zh: (1905-90) a Swedish actor who moved to the US in 1925. Her beauty and acting skills made her one of the first famous Hollywood stars, in silent as well as talking films. She is well known for avoiding the public and for retiring in 1941 to live a life alone in New York. Her films include Queen Christina (1933) and Anna Karenina (1935). “I want to be alone.”Greta Garbo
en: (1905-90) a Swedish actor who moved to the US in 1925. Her beauty and acting skills made her one of the first famous Hollywood stars, in silent as well as talking films. She is well known for avoiding the public and for retiring in 1941 to live a life alone in New York. Her films include Queen Christina (1933) and Anna Karenina (1935). “I want to be alone.”Greta Garbo

zh: 格雷特纳格林（临近英格兰边境的苏格兰村庄，旧时一些英格兰情侣因被禁止在本地结婚而跑到此地成婚，因而闻名）
en: a village in Scotland near the border with England, famous in the past as a place where English couples used to go to get married when they were not allowed to get married in England

zh: 灰色的；烟灰色的；灰白色的
昏暗的；阴沉的
头发花白；头发灰白
苍白的
en: having the colour of smoke or ashes
ex: grey eyes/hair
灰色的眼睛；灰白的头发

zh: 灰色地带，中间区域（界线不明、不易归类、难以界定或处理的领域或形势）
en: an area of a subject or situation that is not clear or does not fit into a particular group and is therefore difficult to define or deal with
ex: Exactly what can be called an offensive weapon is still a grey area.
究竟什么可称作攻击性武器仍然难以界定。

zh: 灰市，水货市场（未经生产公司授权而进口并销售其产品）
（统称）老年顾客，老年客户
en: a system in which products are imported into a country and sold without the permission of the company that produced them

zh: （人的）头脑，脑子
en: a person’s intelligence
ex: This should exercise the old grey matter.
这应该锻炼旧的灰质。

zh: 头发灰白的；头发花白的
en: with grey hair

zh: 老头儿；老翁
en: an old man
ex: the greybeards of the art world
艺术界的老人们

zh: 灵𤟥（身细长、腿长、毛滑、善跑的大赛狗）
en: a large thin dog with smooth hair and long thin legs, that can run very fast and is used in the sport of greyhound racing

zh: any of the buses of Greyhound Lines Inc., the largest US bus company operating between towns and cities. It was established in 1914 and took its present name in 1930 because the buses were painted grey and had a smooth design. They have become part of US life, and one country music song has the title Thank God and Greyhound.
en: any of the buses of Greyhound Lines Inc., the largest US bus company operating between towns and cities. It was established in 1914 and took its present name in 1930 because the buses were painted grey and had a smooth design. They have become part of US life, and one country music song has the title Thank God and Greyhound.
